findings.text: _plan_review_target duplicates the plan-slug reader the repository already owns rather than extending it. reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2367 (_plan_review_pointer_slug) takes a pointer and returns exactly this value, and reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:63 (_plan_review_plan_slug) owns the same prefix-then-round_node_source step; the addition duplicates both, so a change to the identity rule must now be made in three places.

_plan_review_target reads the pointer's node as a mapping, while both existing owners tolerate a bare-string node (recovery_review_dispatch.py:2373 and recovery_review_delivery.py:106 both test isinstance(node, Mapping) and fall back to the string). A live plan-review pointer carrying node as a string would now raise AttributeError inside the promotion sweep instead of taking the delivered-record path, so the new helper is less tolerant of the shapes its siblings accept.

_compose_while_held is defined and never called by either test or by any other helper in the module, and lint does not flag an unused function; it carries the dispatch-hold machinery (queue_dispatch, LanePaused) that the delivered cases do not exercise.
